bar_construction.close: price of the last event by (T,a) inside the token

accepted_input: official Binance Vision aggTrades CSV ZIP
equivalent non-overlapping NDJSON/NDJSON.GZ with a,p,T fields

outcome.long_outcome: first future 20-second close at or above the upper barrier
outcome.short_outcome: first future 20-second close at or below the lower barrier

purpose: independently rejudge disclosed signal outcomes; this is not the private signal-selection recipe

scoring.NO_SIGNAL: not in the signal hit-rate denominator unless its token is unrevealed
scoring.SIGNAL_LONG: HIT only when independent barrier_direction is LONG and timing proof is valid
scoring.SIGNAL_SHORT: HIT only when independent barrier_direction is SHORT and timing proof is valid
scoring.missing_or_late_daily_pack: one MISS for every expected official token in that UTC day
